title: CutRight v2 evidence node (v1)
description: A single, addressable entry in the hierarchical evidence graph. Identity is content-derived; timestamps are rational nanoseconds; producer capability/version, parameter hash, and receipt are mandatory. Raw model prose is NEVER permitted as canonical node identity or timing.

id.description: Stable, content-derived node id (BLAKE3 of canonicalised node body).

source_revision.description: Source revision id that materialised this node. For derived nodes, also see derived_from edges.

range.description: Inclusive-exclusive rational nanosecond range. Omitted for time-less semantic nodes (e.g. editorial_beat grouping).

confidence.description: Producer-supplied confidence in [0, 1]. Required for machine-produced nodes; omitted only for analyst-authored editorial nodes.

parameters_hash.description: BLAKE3 hash of the canonicalised producer parameters object.

model_pack.description: Pack id that contributed the model.

payload_hash.description: BLAKE3 hash of the canonicalised payload object (bounded).

payload.description: Bound the payload size to keep the graph cheap. Producer-defined bounded object.

notes.description: Producer's free-text note. NEVER used as canonical identity or timing.

redacted.description: True iff the payload was redacted for rights or sensitivity; the original payload is unavailable.
